meta.name: VERTEX FORCE
meta.description: Akira Todo has always lived in the shadow of his sister, Haruka, who secretly wields their father’s mysterious “Engine.” But when a mysterious enemy comes for his family, Akira is forced into a battle that threatens the entire world. He may have inherited none of his father’s power, but now he must find a way to fight back. Or risk losing everything he cares about.

videos.title: Engine, Ignition
videos.overview: When the global network is disrupted, Haruka must use a power inherited from her father to protect her family.

videos.title: Vertex
videos.overview: Just after Akira's hidden power reveals itself, two unfamiliar women appear before him.

videos.title: Ardent Feelings
videos.overview: Haruka and Akira depart for Hokkaido with Eleanor and Lala to find the fifth Vertex.

videos.title: Brother and Sister
videos.overview: On a deserted island, Lala devises a plan to use Akira as bait to lure EDVA to them.

videos.title: That's the Answer
videos.overview: As Lala works through the night alone to analyze the Battlenoid, the other four decide to make coffee for her.

videos.title: It's No Mistake
videos.overview: The five Vertex visit a populated island to buy food, but its residents have evacuated due to a typhoon.

videos.title: Today Is the Day
videos.overview: Lala comes up with a way to defeat EDVA, but putting the plan into action isn't so easy.

videos.title: Summer Break for the Five
videos.overview: With EDVA out of the picture, the VERTEX are free to part ways... but Yoko has other ideas.
